Combat Log Parser

Drop your EverQuest Legends log. It shows what you, your pets, and your charmed mobs did — zone session by zone session, fight by fight.

Getting your log

  1. In game, type /log on once. Logging stays on between sessions.
  2. Play a while, then find the file in your EQ Legends folder, under \Logs\.
  3. It's named eqlog_<character>_<server>.txt. Drop it above.

Windows default: C:\Users\Public\Daybreak Game Company\Installed Games\EverQuest Legends\Logs\

Big log? Only the tail is read — enough to cover your recent levels.

Watching your log — the page updates as you play.

Damage over time stances above, invocations below — hover a band for its window

Damage by source

Your side only. you pet charm — a pet is anything that answered you with ", Master."; a charmed mob counts from the moment your own charm cast landed on it. Hover a pet row for who's inside; click it to split by verb.

What hit you

One row per mob ability: melee by verb, spells and DoTs by name. Resisted counts full resists; a partially resisted hit still lands and shows as damage.

What it’s made of

Your melee, ranged & casting

Swing intervals

Measured seconds between swings, per attacker and attack type. This is not the weapon's delay stat: double attacks and haste are folded in, and the log never separates them. Comparing one attacker across two fights cancels those out — if the 95% ranges overlap, the swing rate did not measurably change.

Stance & invocation

Each combo you fought under, its share of combat time, and how your damage looked while it was up.

Healing

You healed

You were healed

Mobs & fights

One row per mob name. Click it for each fight and what the corpses paid — drop rates, coin, XP. A fight ends at the mob's death line, or after 45 quiet seconds if none appeared; click a fight to focus the whole page on it. Mob levels come from your own /con lines — con a mob once and its level fills in. Hover any average for the raw numbers.

Loot

From the auto-loot lines. Coin gained counts corpse coin plus what auto-sell paid. Item links go to the community wikiwiki.
